purpose_context: doc-kitty treats presentations as a first-class output pillar alongside the docsite. Mission M6 lets anyone author a deck in ordinary Markdown (kind: Presentation) and have the build split it into reveal.js slides, rendered out-of-frame with a mandatory no-JS linear fallback, themed through the site's own design tokens, and discoverable in sitemap, llms.txt, the agent API, and search — with no hand-authored slide HTML and no new authoring DSL.
purpose_tldr: Authors write slide decks as plain Markdown; the build renders them as static, accessible reveal.js presentations.
